The '''Gregonia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Dimean sector/Legends|Dimean sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Gregonian salamander]]s.<ref name="GoF" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gregonia system was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-13.<ref name="TEA" />
